card.title: T-26 FI
card.text: Has +2 attack against units with higher attack.
card.flavorText: The T-26 was a Soviet light tank used in various conflicts during the Interwar period and WWII. The underlying T-26 design came from the British Vickers 6-Ton tank and it stood out as one of the most effective tank designs of the 1930s. The Finnish Army used captured T-26s of different models, mainly during the Continuation War, and some tanks served in Finland for various non-combat purposes until 1961. The Finnish experience with captured T-26 tanks was versatile, with the tanks generally considered agile in steering, with reasonable road speed and terrain mobility. However, the suspension system created challenges when it came to accurate aiming while the tank was in motion, and enemy detection proved somewhat difficult. In comparison to captured BT-series tanks, the T-26 tanks were considered more practical and dependable in Finnish conditions, but engine-related problems persisted and efforts to replace it with a more powerful alternative did not materialize.
